claim: The single strongest driver of colour temperature and mood in the entire system. Golden_hour flatters everyone, blue_hour isolates a figure against lights coming on, and deep_night lets you simply delete everything you did not choose to light.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: pre-dawn, dark blue sky, faint horizon glow, before sunrise
sunrise, dawn, orange horizon, low sun
morning, morning light, bright clear light
midday, noon, overhead sun, short shadows
golden hour, warm orange light, long shadows, low sun
dusk, sunset, twilight, purple orange sky
blue hour, deep blue twilight, lights turning on
deep night, midnight, near total darkness, few lights
